items.summary: CNN is hosting a CNN & Jubilee Media town hall with Democratic Texas Senate nominee James Talarico today (announced Oct 5), inviting registered Texas voters to submit questions — his biggest solo TV spotlight since the flu-absence/rumor saga. A Raw Story retelling claims both candidates will appear together in Fort Worth tonight, but CNN's own page names only Talarico; that co-appearance claim is uncorroborated. No Talarico-Paxton debate has been scheduled; Paxton has not publicly responded to Trump's Oct 7 debate demand (AP, Oct 12). Catch-up item missed by earlier runs. Image: reused verified ABC Talarico feed image.
items.title: CNN & Jubilee town hall with James Talarico — today, Oct 14
